text:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing-metering anomaly detected in prod-eu1 — token-count drift vs expected. Severity P2. Runbook: /runbooks/metering-drift :rotating_light:

sre_jen: taking pager, pinging kafka + emitter teams

karen_oncall: I'm joining, assigning myself incident lead — will coordinate customer comms

billing_ops_mike: seeing consumer lag spike on emitter-consumer group `metering-emitter-eu1` ~27k behind; last emit timestamps ~10m ago for a few partitions

eng_ops_omar: looking at emitter logs, lots of 5xx retries from upstream proxies — probable retry storm. dumping tail of emitter logs: 
```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z emitter-12 ERROR request failed status=502 id=abc123 retry=1
2026-03-20T09:12:04Z emitter-12 WARN backoff doubling to 2s
2026-03-20T09:12:05Z emitter-12 ERROR request failed status=502 id=def456 retry=2
```

sre_jen: running quick sanity: kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-eu1:9092 --group metering-emitter-eu1 --describe

eng_ops_omar: output shows lag concentrated on partitions 3,4,5. consumer lag increased at 09:10 UTC correlating with gateway deploy at 09:09 (deploy-batch/infra-proxy).

karen_oncall: rolling back infra-proxy deploy to previous at 09:08 as mitigation, can someone confirm rollback status?

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollback infra-proxy @deploy-bot executed by karen_oncall at 1712304920 — status: started

eng_ops_omar: rollback in progress, redirecting emitter traffic to fallback-routes, will throttle retries on emitter side to reduce pressure

billing_ops_mike: quick check on billing effects — overage flags fired for ~12 customers (internal flag only). No confirmed billing charges yet; counts are inflating due to duplicate retry emissions, so we should pause crediting until reconciled.

support_liz: notifying affected enterprise customers with a brief: we are investigating delayed usage and potential duplicate counts, no confirmed charges yet. Draft message ready for review.

pm_ali: pls add a single-sentence note to status.redwood: "Investigating delayed usage reporting in EU region; ingest is degraded for some customers. No confirmed billing impact yet." I'll post after you approve the wording.

karen_oncall: approved. pm_ali please post and pin. Also start a short-term mitigation plan: 1) pause emitter dedupe window, 2) throttle emitter retries, 3) mark affected window for reconciliation.

eng_ops_omar: throttles applied (retry cap to 3, base backoff increased). Kafka consumer restarted on emitter consumers with reset to last committed offsets to avoid double-processing.

sre_jen: monitoring metrics: token-count delta decreasing but still noisy. Starting a targeted replay/backfill job to reconstruct counts from raw events once pipeline stabilizes. ETA for stable ingest ~15-25m.

billing_ops_mike: action items: hold immediate billing cutover for affected customers, run reconciliation once backfill completes. I'll prepare a list of impacted customer IDs and current provisional flags.

support_liz: customer notify sent to impacted set, included "no confirmed charges; we will reconcile and credit if needed" :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Oncall handoff scheduled: night_oncall_raj will take post-handoff at 1712306800. Please leave clear notes in the incident doc.

karen_oncall: handing off in 30m with full notes — will summarize state in incident doc and handover checklist (what's throttled, rollback status, affected customers list).

night_oncall_raj: ack, I will be on for the handoff and monitor backfill job. Ping me if anything regresses.

pm_ali: request follow-up: add evaluation of auto-fallback policy that triggered; we may need to widen fallback threshold to avoid large retry storms on partial infra regressions.

eng_ops_omar: noted, will open a follow-up ticket for fallback tuning and add postmortem triggers if reconciliation takes >24h.

sre_jen: current status summary (to include in incident doc): rollback started, emitter retries throttled, kafka consumer restarted, backfill job running, ~12 overage flags internal-only, customer notifications sent. Monitoring closely for duplicate emission reduction.

karen_oncall: closing comms loop — next update in 20m or earlier if changes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
